name: report
description: Use when the user wants a report, explainer, form or small interactive tool as one self-contained page, with optional charts, diagrams and sortable tables.

main.description: The page body: lede, findings, sections, charts and tables. No h1; the title becomes it.

aside.description: Report layout only: an optional <aside aria-label=...> with supporting notes, shown beside the main content from 900px and below it on narrower screens.
